projects.title: Automatic Traffic Light System using Arduino UNO
projects.shortDesc: A low-cost embedded traffic signal system designed to automate signal operations using Arduino UNO and programmed LED state sequencing.
projects.fullDesc: The Automatic Traffic Light System using Arduino UNO is an embedded system designed to automate traffic signal operations. The Arduino UNO controls Red, Yellow, and Green LEDs according to predefined time intervals, replicating real-world traffic signal operations without manual intervention.
features: Automatic Red → Green → Yellow → Red state machine sequencing
Programmable timing delays for peak and off-peak traffic flow
Low-cost hardware design with current-limiting resistor protection
Continuous autonomous operation with expansion capability for sensors
Successfully tested circuit layout demonstrating microcontroller timing precision
projects.architecture: Power Supply Unit → Arduino UNO (ATmega328P) → GPIO Digital Pin Control → Current-Limiting Resistors → Signal LEDs (Red / Yellow / Green)

projects.title: Smart Grid Monitoring System
projects.shortDesc: An IoT and Edge-AI based system for real-time monitoring, current leakage detection, and renewable energy optimization.
projects.fullDesc: An intelligent power grid monitoring framework using ESP32 dual-core processors, ACS712 current sensors, and ZMPT101B voltage modules. Edge-AI algorithms evaluate instantaneous AC voltage and current waveforms locally to detect phase imbalances, neutral current leakage, and harmonic power factor drops.
features: Real-time RMS voltage and current wave sampling
Sub-second current leakage fault detection
Automatic solid-state relay trip isolation during overcurrent events
Telemetry streamed via MQTT to cloud analytics dashboard
projects.architecture: Grid Power Lines → ACS712/ZMPT101B Probes → ESP32 Edge AI Processor → Anomaly Detection -> SSR Relay Isolation & Cloud Telemetry

projects.title: IoT-Based Smart Elder Care System with Real-Time Fall Detection
projects.shortDesc: An IoT-based monitoring system designed to improve elderly safety using MPU6050 accelerometer fall detection, DHT22 environmental sensors, and ESP32 real-time emergency alert telemetry.
projects.fullDesc: This project is an IoT-based monitoring system designed to improve the safety of elderly people. It uses sensors such as an MPU6050 accelerometer to detect sudden falls and DHT22 to monitor environmental conditions. The system processes the sensor data using an ESP32 and can provide real-time alerts when abnormal movement or a possible fall is detected.
features: Real-time fall detection
Motion and activity monitoring
Temperature and humidity monitoring
ESP32-based IoT connectivity
Emergency alert system
Continuous elderly safety monitoring
projects.architecture: Sensors (MPU6050 & DHT22) → ESP32 Microcontroller → 3-Axis Impact & Motion Vector Analysis → Emergency Alert Trigger & IoT Telemetry

projects.title: TinyML-Based Predictive Maintenance System for Industrial Motors
projects.shortDesc: An embedded system designed to monitor motor vibration and temperature data for real-time fault detection using sensors and TinyML.
projects.fullDesc: A TinyML-Based Predictive Maintenance System is an embedded system designed to monitor the condition of industrial motors and identify early signs of faults. Sensors such as an MPU6050 accelerometer and DHT22 temperature sensor collect vibration and temperature data from the motor. The collected data is processed using a TinyML model to detect abnormal operating conditions and predict potential motor failures before they occur.
features: Real-time motor vibration and temperature monitoring
TinyML-based fault detection
Early identification of abnormal conditions
Reduces unexpected motor breakdowns
Low-cost Arduino/ESP32-based implementation
Supports preventive and predictive maintenance
projects.architecture: Industrial Motor → MPU6050 & DHT22 Sensors → Arduino/ESP32 TinyML Model → Real-Time Fault Telemetry

projects.title: Traffic Light Water Quality Tester
projects.shortDesc: A water-quality monitoring system that uses sensor measurements and traffic-light style indication.
projects.fullDesc: An intuitive water purity diagnostic instrument measuring Total Dissolved Solids (TDS), pH levels, and Turbidity. Translates multi-parameter hydro-chemical data into immediate Red/Yellow/Green traffic light LED safety indicators for quick public assessment.
features: Simultaneous multi-sensor probing: TDS (PPM), pH value, and Nephelometric Turbidity
Traffic light visual status: Green (Safe), Yellow (Caution), Red (Unsafe)
Integrated OLED display for numeric telemetry and parameter breakdown
Portable battery-operated design for field testing
projects.architecture: Hydro-Probes (TDS, pH, Turbidity) -> Signal Amplifier -> Analog-to-Digital Processing -> Water Quality Index Classifier -> LED & OLED Display
